descriptionByLocale.en:
Our modern radiology department covers the entire spectrum of imaging diagnostics. These include:
  • Conventional X-ray
  • Ultrasound
  • Computed tomography (CT)
  • Magnetic resonance imaging (MR)
  • Mammography
  • Interventional radiology and radiographic diagnostics
Our team consists of around 30 radiology specialists (RFP)/students as well as 2 medical practice assistants (MPA). Tasks: Support as a student assistant You join our team especially during marginal times, weekends and public holidays. Operational periods The missions are flexible according to agreement: During the week • Support at marginal times from about 16:00 to about 22:00 Weekends and public holidays • Assignments from about 12:00 to about 20:00 The exact assignment planning takes place individually and in mutual agreement. Requirements We are addressing in particular: • Medical students • Students in Healthcare • General students with an interest in everyday hospital life and patient contact Ideally, they have the following characteristics: • Empathetic and respectful treatment of patients • Enjoyment of working in the interprofessional team • High reliability and responsibility • Resilience and calm action even in hectic situations • Self-employed and careful working methods • Good communication skills • Flexibility in terms of working hours • Discretion and professional appearance • Interest in medical procedures and radiological examinations Experience in health care is beneficial, but not a requirement. We offer: • 28-33 paid leave days per year • Extensive opportunities for further education and training, e.g. own seminar program with a wide range of educational opportunities • Occupational health management with preventive measures such as ergonomic advice in the workplace • Part-time work and possibility of job sharing also in management functions • Bright, friendly rooms with modern infrastructure • Strong values and actively lived corporate culture • Characterisation and participation of the Claraspital by the employees The Claraspital, the largest private hospital in Basel, is a university teaching and research hospital with a full service mandate for highly specialized abdominal surgery and a supra-regional broadcast of its centers "Bäu" and "Tumor" as well as its special fields. In the Claraspital, employees find jobs where they can develop both professionally and humanly. At Claraspital, we attach great importance to consciously nurturing and developing our corporate culture and actively living the cultural criteria developed together "together - competently - responsibly".
